about: The mutant ledger of internal/sketch/syntax: edits of the parser's derived forms that the package's tests must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./internal/sketch/syntax; a unit that cannot afford the coverage pass applies each edit by hand and runs the killer. Seeded by wf10 batch-15 fix-r2 (L11b M1).

mutants.name: builtin-target-any-name
mutants.rule: An extern target with no import path names a Go builtin.

mutants.name: gx11-pair-append-no-law
mutants.from:
if len(params) == 2 && len(params[0].Names) == 1 && len(params[1].Names) == 1 {
		appends = true
mutants.to:
if len(params) == 2 && len(params[0].Names) == 1 && len(params[1].Names) == 1 {
		return nil, nil, false, false
mutants.rule: types.md Codecs 7: the append form of a pair derives the round-trip law too (GX11).

mutants.name: gx11-pair-append-no-into
mutants.rule: types.md Codecs 7: the append form's law calls Wire with an empty buffer (GX11).

mutants.name: rc4b-format-drops-derive
mutants.rule: ergo fmt prints a derive as written (patterns.md, Derivation; the decided fixture derive.ergo formats to itself).

mutants.name: try1-groups-right
mutants.rule: grammar.md Expressions 1 (q105): a try in operand position wraps its operand only; it adds no grouping.
